items.title: Dragon Island
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Feel safe with these mighty dragons protecting your village!

+ Great dragons in the clouds
+ By 4KS Studios and Street Studios

items.title: Trees & Leaves Disguise
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Check out this exciting update, including five additional skins! Choose from a variety of different leaves and wood disguises to really blend in. Prank your friends and have fun with this pack!
items.changelog:
-Update includes (5) new skins! 
-Mangrove Wood
-Mangrove Leaves
-Cocoa Beans
-Dark Oak Wood
-Azalea Leaves

items.title: Block Gamers
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description: These Blocks are gamers! Check out these awesome Neon Gamer Outfits!

items.title: Space Animals
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Known as the A.N.I.M.A.L. unit, these experienced explorers specialize in deep space exploration operations, exploring as yet unknown lands.
Play as one of them and go on an adventure!

- 20 HD space animals skins!
- Choose between regular & helmetless characters!
- Ideal for roleplay!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Rainbow Fashion HD
items.creator: House of How
items.description: A skin pack of rainbow color fashion! These teens have mad style. Perfect for those summer parties and back-to-school moments. 9 skins with unique, neon outfits.

items.title: RGB Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Do you like RGB colors? Wear them on your clothes! Be an RGB teen and be bright and colorful!

+ 9 RGB skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Tornado Parkour
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Tornado Parkour is a new experience that will take you traveling through a natural disaster as you try and keep your footing on your way to the top! Can you conquer the storm? Try alone or with friends!

+ Great for beginners and pros
+ Checkpoints along the way!
+ By ArgoStudios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Chunk Challenge
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Do you accept this challenge? Survive in small 16x16 chunks with limited resources.

+ By Street Studios

items.title: Axolotl Gentlemen & Ladies
items.creator: DigiPort
items.description:
Are you ready for prom? You will amaze everyone with your sweetness and elegance.

- 12 axolotl themed skins
- 2 free skins!
- By rvan

items.title: Anime Drip Style
items.creator: DigiPort
items.description:
The coolest anime skins are here. Rest assured you've never been this cool before.

- 12 anime themed skins.
- 2 free skins!
- By rvan

items.title: Nether Nekos
items.creator: Snail Studios
items.description:
Neko's are here! All eyes are on these anime cats, as they start taking over the world one step at a time. Rain as supreme overlords for the next thousand millennium!

+ 8 Neko-themed skins with gremlin-like personalities!
+ Roleplay as sinister Neko's from another world!
+ Perfect for anime or animal lovers!

items.title: Animal Teens
items.creator: Snail Studios
items.description:
Show off your love for animals with these trendy outfits! Check out the fun teen hats and hoodies with playful colors!

+10 uniquely designed animal outfits!

items.title: Monster Slayer
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Fight 12 new epic boss fights! Are you able to beat all of them? A dragon, a cyclops, a giant, and many other monsters are threatening the lives of the people in the village, can you, the Monster Slayer slay these monsters and free the village from its threats?

+ 12 new boss fights!
+ Dragon!
+ Ghost!
+ Skin included!
+ Custom Music!

items.title: Hype Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
The most hype and trendy teens have arrived in the city. Pick the coolest and most fashionable clothes out there! Along with your buddies, you can be the most awesome teen this summer!

- 8 amazing skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns.

items.title: Luxury Freestyle Demons
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
If you're going to be a demon, do it in style! Luxury Freestyle demons includes 10 uniquely themed skins great for every occasion!

- Demon-themed skins 
- Licensed by 5 Frame Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Black and Pink
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Black and Pink! Your two favorite colors just came together to create these 12 awesome teen outfits for you to rock this style. Be the star of your Minecraft world!

- 12 black and pink skins
- 1 free skin
- Licensed by Dragon Blocks and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Fresh Fashion Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Feeling fashionable will have no limits with this skin pack! 12 unique designs for you to wear the latest fashion of the city, a unique style that will steal all eyes, ready to feel the freshness of fashion?

- 12 skins
- 1 skin free!
- Licensed by Team Snowflake and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: World's Safest Mansions
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Welcome to the World's Safest Mansions! These millionaire mansions are well protected with the safest defense system in the world. Enjoy these giant mansions defended by lava, water, large walls, cactuses, and more.

+ Includes 6 millionaire houses
+ This world is great for survival or roleplay

items.title: God Mode Base
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
God Mode Base is a massive castle that provides you with overpowered weapons, tools, armor, and more! Explore the world and destroy anything in your way with the most OP equipment in Minecraft. 

- God armor, weapons, tools and items
- Massive castle base
- Great for single player or multiplayer
- Survival or roleplay world

By Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Skywars Fighters
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
The skywars are raging! Fight the best you can, defeat your enemies to be the king of the islands! Play as these charismatic and tough characters available in the Skywars Fighters pack. There's something for everyone!
+ 1 free skin
+ 15 skins

items.title: Street Fashion
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These teens are out to make a statement! With eye-catching dyed hairstyles and branded fashion trends you're sure to be the centre of attention out on the street. Show off your urban merch with Street Fashion!

- 8 skins!
- Pick the perfect outfit that suits you!

items.title: Parkour Paradise 3
items.creator: Hielke Maps
items.description:
Parkour Paradise 3 is a MASSIVE parkour map containing 100 fun and exciting levels to beat! Play alone or with friends!

* 100 levels
* Rising lava levels
* Snake levels
* Many unique level themes!
* Multiplayer friendly!
* Ranking system!
* Nearly double the size of Parkour Paradise 2!

items.title: Millionaire Teens
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Live like a king, have the best cars, luxurious homes and, of course, dress in style! Enjoy these 12 amazing skins and have everything you ever dreamed of.

+ 2 free skins

items.title: Cute Pastels
items.creator: Impulse
items.description: Live your life in a beautiful pastel world and rock an adorable outfit showing off your style! Choose from a variety of different colors and looks! With 12 skins in this pack, you're sure to find the perfect one for you!
